t: 25 houseplants that survive almost anything
d: If you have killed things before, start here. These tolerate low light, irregular watering and general neglect. The most common way people kill all of them is overwatering, not under. #houseplants #beginnerplants #plantcare

t: 18 houseplants that will not poison your cat or dog
d: Every plant here is non-toxic to cats and dogs. Note that most toxic houseplants cause mouth irritation and an upset stomach rather than anything worse, but if you want to stop worrying entirely, start with this list. #petsafeplants #catsafeplants #houseplants

t: The houseplants that are genuinely difficult - and what they need
d: These are the ones that drop leaves, crisp at the edges and generally punish guesswork. Humidity and water quality matter far more than for the easy plants. #houseplants #plantcare #planttips
